claims.head: Philadelphia pounces on mistakes, and Detroit makes them
claims.call: At least its usual 7.7% of Philadelphia’s 5-on-5 chances come right after winning the puck.
claims.body: Detroit gives up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most (27th of 32 at avoiding breakdowns). Philadelphia ranks 7th for chances off turnovers.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 5 and 3 games this season

check.measure: share of 5-on-5 expected goals within 5 seconds of winning the puck
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Forecheck against patience
claims.body: On forecheck pressure, Detroit sits 9th of 32, at the hounding end of the scale. Philadelphia is 28th, at the passive end.
claims.call: Detroit puts more forecheck pressure on than Philadelphia.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 5 and 3 games this season

check.rule: held if the team comes out ahead by at least half its usual margin; partly if it comes out ahead by less; otherwise didn't happen

notes.text: S. Edvinsson has not played this season. A. Johansson is in his usual spot beside M. Seider, up from third-pair minutes last season. That pair is getting 10:31 a game at 5-on-5, down from 16:09 with Edvinsson.

DET.head: Detroit starts a half-step ahead
DET.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Detroit has home ice. Philadelphia can still swing it if it pounces on loose pucks.

PHI.head: Philadelphia starts a half-step behind
PHI.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Detroit has home ice. Philadelphia can tip it if it pounces on loose pucks.
